versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Market Report skill.
- Generates comprehensive crypto market reports using CoinMarketCap MCP data.
- Covers market cap, dominance, fear & greed, altcoin season, BTC/ETH snapshot, technical analysis, derivatives, trending sectors, and catalysts.
- Provides workflow for assembling a one-stop summary, adapting report detail based on user query.
- Built-in error handling: delivers partial reports and clearly notes any unavailable data.
